synopsis: Chapter 8 lists the Caterpillar 797F mining truck at 623,690 kg rated gross mass and a 363 t nominal payload, citing manufacturer specifications [f5962]. The glossary restates these figures as approximately 624 t fully loaded or gross mass, with a 363 t payload [f11373, f11401, f13617]. These are consistent rounded restatements, not competing mass estimates [f5962, f11373, f11401, f13617]. For planning, the figures describe the machine’s specified mass and payload; they are not performance measurements and therefore do not establish measured braking performance [f5964].
